subject: Renewal kickoff: term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@peakdata.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the product review last week. As PeakData's renewal is approaching, I'd like to kick off the coordination to align on three things before the QBR:

1) Term options (12 vs 24 months) and pricing for the uplift we discussed.
2) Capacity plan: expected average throughput and a short burst window for seasonal traffic.
3) QBR scheduling — a 60-minute slot in July to review metrics and sign-off path.

Attached is a refreshed proposal (v3) that reflects the 20% uplift you signaled and two term options. High-level asks from our side: a) confirm target start date for expanded capacity (ideally Aug 1), b) indicate procurement timeline so we can route the SOW/PO.

Proposed next steps:
- You review v3 and mark a preferred term by Thu (4th).
- We set a 60-min QBR the week of July 15 — pick two windows and we'll lock one.
- Grace will own the technical runbook and validation steps; Laura will coordinate billing/contract items.

Can you confirm who on your side should be on the QBR (procurement, engineering, ops)?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the proposal.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Enterprise Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Proposal_v3.pdf (proposal, 6 pages)
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@peakdata.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Whitaker <t.whitaker@peakdata.com>, procurement@peakdata.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2029 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the proposal and the clear next steps. Quick replies:
- We'll target the Aug 1 start for capacity uplift; engineering asked for a two-week validation window starting July 22.
- For QBR attendees: Tom (ops lead), myself (owner), and our procurement alias. I'll loop in Ana from finance if we need PO guidance.
- Procurement timeline: we usually need 3–4 weeks for PO once terms are agreed.

Can you add an explicit checklist for the July 22 validation window (integration tests, traffic ramp, rollback plan)? Also please include an item for data retention/retention policy confirmation — security flagged that as a dependency.

Available QBR windows (pick one):
- Tue Jul 16, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Jul 18, 14:00–15:00 PT

Tom and procurement are cc'd — Tom, are you ok with the July 22 validation window and the proposed ramp?

Thanks,
Elena
VP, Platform
PeakData
From: Tom Whitaker <t.whitaker@peakdata.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@peakdata.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@peakdata.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2029 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

On Mon, Jul 1, 2029 at 9:48 AM Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@peakdata.com> wrote:
> Can you add an explicit checklist for the July 22 validation window (integration tests, traffic ramp, rollback plan)?

Karthik — we're aligned to the July 22 validation window. High-level engineering constraints:
- We can do up to a 3x baseline traffic ramp in a controlled test over 48 hours.
- Any change requiring schema / request contract updates needs 5 business days lead time.
- Procurement: we'll aim to have a PO ready by Jul 26 if terms are agreed by Jul 12.

I'll rely on your runbook for the ramp steps.

Tom
Head of Ops
PeakData
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@peakdata.com>, Tom Whitaker <t.whitaker@peakdata.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2029 12:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Thanks Tom — good to have the constraints. Elena / Tom, here's an updated plan and who owns what (short checklist included inline).

High-level plan (timeline):
- By Jul 4: PeakData confirms term option (12 vs 24) and target start date (Elena).
- Jul 8–12: Redwood finalizes SOW and sends redline-ready contract (Laura).
- Jul 15–19: QBR (week) — finalize one of the proposed slots.
- Jul 22–23: Validation window (engineering ramp & tests).
- Jul 26–Aug 1: Procurement/PO issuance and change freeze; Aug 1 capacity uplift go-live.

Owners and items:
- Karthik (me): overall coordination, QBR slides, and escalation path.
- Grace O'Connor: validation runbook, test plan, rollback steps, on-call during ramp.
- Laura Bennett: SOW and billing items, invoice schedule, and contract redlines.
- Marissa Cole: pricing confirmation and discount approvals; will prepare updated price deck.

Validation checklist (Grace to own):
- Integration smoke test (end-to-end sample requests)
- KV cache sanity and prefix performance check
- Traffic ramp script (0 → 3x over 48 hrs) with monitoring thresholds
- Latency/cost baseline capture and acceptance criteria
- Rollback trigger conditions and playbook
- Data retention/retention policy confirmation (Laura will add a note to the SOW)

Attachments: QBR_Agenda_July.xlsx (draft agenda) — included for the Jul 16/18 slot decision.

Next actions: Elena, confirm which QBR slot you prefer by EOD Wed Jul 3 and who from procurement will be point-of-contact. Laura / Marissa / Grace — I have action items to produce assets by Jul 8.

Thanks — will also spin up a shared folder with the runbook and proposal links.

Best,
Karthik

> On a small note: Marissa will review the two term price schedules and flag the recommended cadence for billing (monthly vs quarterly).
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@peakdata.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Whitaker <t.whitaker@peakdata.com>, procurement@peakdata.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Karthik / team —

Thanks for the clear plan. We'll take the Jul 16, 10–11 PT slot for the QBR. Procurement will be represented by Ana Morales (procurement@peakdata.com) — Ana, looping you in.

We prefer the 24-month term for budget predictability. Please proceed with the SOW reflecting 24 months and the Aug 1 go-live target. For billing cadence, monthly invoicing works best for us.

Action items confirmed:
- Elena: confirm term (done, 24 months).
- Ana (procurement): aim for PO by Jul 26.
- Redwood: send redline-ready SOW by Jul 8 and runbook by Jul 12.

See you all on Tue Jul 16 — I'll send an invite once Ana confirms.

Best,
Elena
